decisions.reason: The pipe cleaning box extends the firm's established fluid-handling and utility offer, and with industry turnover growing there is no shortfall against aspirations to trigger search for other uses of the resources.
Public waste bins are distant from the core business and so carry more uncertainty, but they serve the same public-sector buyers and the industry growth gives enough slack to carry them for now.
Ground sleeves for posts build directly on the firm's steel fabrication and coating skills, so they are cheap to maintain and show no sign of falling short.
Cast iron sleeves complement the existing sleeve line, though their overlap with the steel variants creates some risk of consolidating the range.
Steel ground sleeves fit best with the firm's core steel processing and in-house surface treatment, which makes them the most likely sleeve variant to be kept.
